instruction: A Windsor chair with a curved bent back bow, several thin turned spindles forming the back, a solid contoured saddle seat, and four slightly splayed turned legs joined by stretchers. Readable joinery, warm wood.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a Windsor chair. A Windsor chair with a curved bent back bow, several thin turned spindles forming the back, a solid contoured saddle seat, and four slightly splayed turned legs joined by stretchers. Readable joinery, warm wood. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
